justifications.type_expressiveness: The error enum encodes every meaningful failure mode with carrying data (the offending value/char), and the small domain has no other distinctions left to model.
justifications.error_handling: Typed enum with informative, distinguishing variants; no unwrap/expect/panic in library code, and checked_add guards against overflow on the parsing path.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with module and per-item doc comments including Errors sections, sensible derives (Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq), and a manual Display impl following std conventions.
justifications.idiomaticity: Concise greedy table, idiomatic match on chars, slice-based parsing without unnecessary allocations or clones, and a clean canonicity check via round-trip equality.
